print_usage() {

  --build-only            Incrementally build full stack (runtime, forward, device_manager, ui_gateway, host) and exit
  --status                Show running status of all stack daemons and probe HTTP health
  --stop                  Gracefully stop all managed stack daemons and clean up PID files
  --foreground, -f        Run ui-gateway in foreground after starting background services
  --help, -h              Show this help message
EOF

                exit 2
            fi
            CONFIG_PATH="$2"
            EXPLICIT_CONFIG=1
            shift 2
            ;;
        --mode)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --mode requires <sim|hardware>" >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            CLI_MODE="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;

            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --uart requires a device path" >&2

            CLI_UART="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;

            if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: --baud requires a baud rate" >&2

                echo "ERROR: --port requires a port number" >&2

            shift 2

        --build-only)
            DO_BUILD_ONLY=1
            shift

        --status)
            DO_STATUS=1
            shift
            ;;
        --stop)
            DO_STOP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --foreground|-f)
            DO_FOREGROUND=1
            shift

        --help|-h)

            ;;
        *)

    local name="$1"

static bool baud_to_speed(uint32_t baud, speed_t* speed) noexcept {
    if (speed == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (baud) {
        case 9600:
            *speed = B9600;
            return true;
        case 19200:
            *speed = B19200;
            return true;
        case 38400:
            *speed = B38400;
            return true;
        case 57600:
            *speed = B57600;
            return true;
        case 115200:
            *speed = B115200;
            return true;
        case 230400:
            *speed = B230400;
            return true;
#ifdef B460800
        case 460800:
            *speed = B460800;
            return true;
#endif
#ifdef B921600
        case 921600:
            *speed = B921600;
            return true;
#endif
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

static bool configure_termios(int fd, speed_t speed) noexcept {
    if (fd < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    struct termios tty{};
    if (tcgetattr(fd, &tty) != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    cfsetospeed(&tty, speed);
    cfsetispeed(&tty, speed);

    // 8N1 raw configuration
    tty.c_cflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~PARENB);
    tty.c_cflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~CSTOPB);
    tty.c_cflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~CSIZE);
    tty.c_cflag |= CS8;
    tty.c_cflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~CRTSCTS);
    tty.c_cflag |= (CLOCAL | CREAD);

    tty.c_lflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~(ICANON | ECHO | ECHOE | ISIG));
    tty.c_iflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~(IXON | IXOFF | IXANY));
    tty.c_iflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~(IGNBRK | BRKINT | PARMRK | ISTRIP | INLCR | IGNCR | ICRNL));
    tty.c_oflag &= static_cast<tcflag_t>(~OPOST);

    tty.c_cc[VMIN] = 0;
    tty.c_cc[VTIME] = 0;

    return tcsetattr(fd, TCSANOW, &tty) == 0;
}

bool serial_open(const SerialConfig* config, SerialContext* ctx) noexcept {
    if (config == nullptr || ctx == nullptr || config->device_path == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    speed_t speed = B921600;
    if (!baud_to_speed(config->baud_rate, &speed)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (ctx->is_open && ctx->fd >= 0) {
        serial_close(ctx);
    }

    const int fd = open(config->device_path, O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (fd < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!configure_termios(fd, speed)) {
        close(fd);
        return false;
    }

    tcflush(fd, TCIOFLUSH);
    ctx->fd = fd;
    ctx->is_open = true;
    return true;
}

void serial_close(SerialContext* ctx) noexcept {
    if (ctx == nullptr) {
        return;
    }
    if (ctx->fd >= 0) {
        close(ctx->fd);
    }
    ctx->fd = -1;
    ctx->is_open = false;
}

static bool wait_for_writable(int fd, int timeout_ms) noexcept {
    if (fd < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    struct pollfd pfd{};
    pfd.fd = fd;
    pfd.events = POLLOUT;

    const int poll_res = poll(&pfd, 1, timeout_ms);
    if (poll_res <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    const short err_mask = static_cast<short>(POLLERR | POLLHUP | POLLNVAL);
    if ((pfd.revents & err_mask) != 0) {
        return false;
    }
    return (pfd.revents & POLLOUT) != 0;
}

bool serial_write(SerialContext* ctx,
                  const uint8_t* data,
                  size_t size,
                  size_t* bytes_written) noexcept {
    if (bytes_written != nullptr) {
        *bytes_written = 0;
    }
    if (ctx == nullptr || !ctx->is_open || ctx->fd < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    if (size == 0) {
        return true;
    }
    if (data == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t total_written = 0;
    int budget_ms = 1000;
    while (total_written < size && budget_ms > 0) {
        const size_t remaining = size - total_written;
        const ssize_t res = write(ctx->fd, data + total_written, remaining);
        if (res > 0) {
            total_written += static_cast<size_t>(res);
            continue;
        }
        const bool is_block = (res < 0) && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK || errno == EINTR);
        if (is_block) {
            const int slice_ms = (budget_ms < 50) ? budget_ms : 50;
            if (!wait_for_writable(ctx->fd, slice_ms)) {
                break;
            }
            budget_ms -= slice_ms;
            continue;
        }
        break;
    }

    if (bytes_written != nullptr) {
        *bytes_written = total_written;
    }
    return (total_written == size);
}
